steps.caption: Option 3B · Connections. A bar panel maps the page in front to its neighbours.
Below the map: links from this page, linked here, shares with, people, and names not linked yet.
Not linked yet: one press turns the name in the text into a link, and the row moves up.
Click any row or node: that page opens beside, and the panel follows it.
The page itself never changes; connections live in the panel.
